question:
**From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Now I will not shoot a sloth bear wantanly but unfortunately for the poor beast.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is '**wantanly**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**wantanly**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Wantonly**'.
 
• It means 'in a deliberate and unprovoked way. (जानबूझकर और अकारण तरीके से)'
 
 
• *Example: She could not believe that she had behaved so **wantonly**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *wantanly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **unfortunately**: used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect. (कहा करते थे कि कोई चीज दुखद, निराशाजनक है या उसका बुरा प्रभाव पड़ता है)
 
• **sloth**: a slow-moving tropical American mammal that hangs upside down from the branches of trees using its long limbs and hooked claws. 
 
• **beast**: an animal, especially a large one. (बड़ा पशु या जानवर)
